designationHistory.name: Hutchinson Lake Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the refuge as the Hutchinson Lake Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by Executive Order 8121.
designationHistory.note: Renamed Hutchinson Lake National Wildlife Refuge by Proclamation 2416, July 25, 1940. Also printed in the Federal Register, May 12, 1939.
